vendor-logistics: Heads up — planning to ship 20x H100 replacements for your fleet. NA pool (10 units) air ETA 2026-04-12, EU pool (10 units) sea ETA 2026-04-18. We need confirmation on two things ASAP:

vendor-logistics: 1) Are split AWBs acceptable (we'll send separate AWB per depot)? 2) Which manifest CSV schema do you ingest today? Our portal uses a slightly different header than the one in your ticket.

mira: Split AWBs are ok for NA, prefer single AWB for EU if possible (customs is finicky). For manifests, we need serial->node mapping and RMA id in the same row.

vendor-logistics: noted. Current CSV header we have is:

```
AWB,AWB_piece,sku,serial,rma_id,warehouse,eta,value_usd,hs_code
```

vendor-logistics: Portal example from your docs is: `awb,serial,rma,ship_to_location,eta` — missing a few fields. Which one should we send?

sam: For the Dedicated pools we need `node_tag` too so ops can reconcile when units land. If you can include `node_tag` column that's ideal.

lia: Also confirm whether the RMA labels include the node_tag barcode. Last batch came without node mapping and we had to do manual mapping — big time sink. :grimacing:

vendor-logistics: we can add `node_tag`, but question on labels — we typically print `rma_id` + serial barcode only. Attaching a sample label name: `RMA-<rma_id>-<serial>.pdf`. Do you need `node_tag` in the label itself?

jordan: If we can avoid manual steps, yes — include `node_tag`. Warehouse import automation expects a column `node_tag` and a barcode on the label. Otherwise we queue to ops.

mira: cost question — what's the delta to air-ship the EU 10 units (instead of sea)? We might want to top off EU pool if expedite cost is reasonable.

vendor-logistics: air uplift for EU 10 units is $18k additional (door-to-door, includes expedited customs broker). Sea is covered under current contract. If you decide by EOD we can reroute.

sam: Ops note — if you reroute to air, we need updated ETA and AWB at least 24h before arrival to raise a depot slot. Also confirm whether the replacement units are new or refurbished (affects acceptance flow).

vendor-logistics: replacements are refurbished A-grade, flashed to stock image. We'll include refurbishment certs and photos.

lia: Please include photos and unit temperature/packaging notes. If any unit has firmware mismatches we'll tag and quarantine automatically.

vendor-logistics: Understood. One more: return labels for DOA units — do you want us to include outbound RMA return labels in the same pallet (so depot can hand back) or send email labels?

mira: Send physical return labels in the pallet. Depot staff are better at sticking labels than chasing emails.

vendor-logistics: OK — we'll add `node_tag` column, include photos + ref certs, and ship with physical return labels for NA. For EU we'll hold off on air unless you confirm. AWB plan: NA split AWBs per depot, EU single AWB if sea stays.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4821 created for depot recon and import automation. Assigned to @jordan.

jordan: I got the ticket. I'll patch the import to accept `node_tag` and run a dry import once you send the CSV. Please attach a 10-line sample CSV to the ticket so we can validate headers.

vendor-logistics: Will upload sample CSV in INC-4821 and ping here when done. Thanks — aiming to ship NA air on 2026-04-08 if we get final OK. :thumbsup:

mira: Confirmed — NA air OK. Please proceed and tag INC-4821 when manifest uploaded. We will evaluate EU air decision tomorrow morning.

vendor-logistics: Roger that, standing by.
